semantic_contract.task_statement: Determine all divisors of a positive integer.

result.canonical_semantics: Positive divisors of the supplied positive integer in ascending order.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite evaluates divisors for one, a prime, a representative composite and a larger composite, with interaction-only invalid-input evidence retained separately. Zero and negative integers are outside the positive-integer contract and are boundary probes.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 5 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Zero and negative integers are outside the POSITIVE_INTEGER contract and are measured only by the semantic-boundary probe stream.
